_README: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers extend Claude Code with external capabilities.
To activate these, copy the mcpServers block into your settings.json or settings.local.json.
Install each server with the command shown, then add your API keys.

filesystem._description: Gives Claude direct filesystem access to the project. Already built-in to Claude Code — this is just for reference.

brave-search._description: Web search. Useful for looking up Next.js docs, Tailwind v4 syntax, shadcn/ui API, etc. Get API key at https://brave.com/search/api/
brave-search._install: No install needed — uses npx automatically

github._description: Access GitHub repos, issues, PRs for BrainTrust. Lets Claude create PRs, comment on issues, read repo info.

sequential-thinking._description: Gives Claude a scratchpad for step-by-step reasoning. Useful for complex debugging or architecture decisions.

memory._description: Persistent memory across sessions using a local knowledge graph. Claude can store and recall facts between conversations.

puppeteer._description: Browser automation. Claude can open a browser, navigate to localhost:3000, screenshot, and check the UI visually.
